items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Lester was with Basie... Ben said, Hap, hey, where you going? I said, let's go up there and hear the battle between Basie and Hawk.

ctx.x: Yeah, because now when Lester came in, Lester came in -- Lester was supposed to go with Fletcher, and then Ben went with Fletcher. Ben didn't have -- those guys was funny -- [Bird] (unintelligible) didn't impress me nothing. Lester -- kind of like a showmanship, you know -- and Lester walk up, set his horn on his shoulder, you know, (unintelligible). So Ben came and said to me, said, look at that son of a bitch over there, going up Seventh Avenue with that horn on his --

items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: And they call him Vice Pres.

ctx.x: Good copy, see. And they call him Vice Pres.
